# U.K. Rehabilitation Robots Market, 2025-2030

The rehabilitation robots market in the UK is expected to reach a projected revenue of US$ 31.8 million by 2030. A compound annual growth rate of 12.3% is expected of the UK rehabilitation robots market from 2025 to 2030.

Revenue, 2024 (US$M) $15.7 

Forecast, 2030 (US$M) $31.8 

CAGR, 2025 - 2030 12.3%

### Global Market

## UK rehabilitation robots market highlights

- The UK rehabilitation robots market generated a revenue of USD 15.7 million in 2024 and is expected to reach USD 31.8 million by 2030.
- The UK market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 12.3% from 2025 to 2030.
- In terms of segment, exoskeletons was the largest revenue generating type in 2024.
- Therapy Robots is the most lucrative type segment registering the fastest growth during the forecast period.
